name: @amykit/plugin-prove
description: Proves a phase against the real system: one workflow walks the scenario each brief settled, through the operations the mounted plugins offer.
author: Nicolas Melo

amy.about: Use it as the proving phase of a project, once a brief has settled the scenario the work must pass. It is a workflow that walks that scenario against the real system through the operations mounted plugins offer, such as agent-browser, agent-desktop and terminal, and records a proof. It needs file-brief-store and a notifier; mount command for the resources a scenario runs against and the code digest, and a conversation so it can ask a person to make a fixture hold.
